name: dsh-find-bar
description: DSH web plugin: a Cmd/Ctrl+F find bar for the desktop Electron shell, which has none. Typing only marks and counts (the view jumps only on Enter, anchored to your viewport), multi-select scope (chat/panel/both) that can follow the focus region (selection, then last click), match-case and whole-word toggles, highlight-all, Enter/Shift+Enter navigation.
